messages.subject: read.cross too many individuals
parts:
I have just imported my data and estimated the map. It looks great
but there is one detail that's off. There are 2 extra individuals in
the data when I read.cross. I'm using a .csv file.
I *think* it's due to the first 2 lines in my .csv that have the
phenotype and marker names, and the chromosome identifiers.
I'm just getting started with R and R qtl, so I assume this is
something simple--something to define those first two lines as
non-genotypic data?

Thanks,
Jane
